summary.bn: prefix আর postfix আলাদা করে trace করো এবং একই expression-এ অসুরক্ষিত update এড়াও।

notes: Prefix and postfix integer updates have long existed in C. C11 introduced the modern sequencing terminology used here. Under the C17 baseline, i = i++ remains undefined; do not transfer rules from a different programming language.

examples.title: Use the current ticket first
examples.explanationHtml: Postfix supplies the current ticket, four, to issued. The update leaves ticket at five before printf runs. This matches giving out a number and preparing its successor. Two different variables make the old and new values visible.

examples.title: Advance before assigning
examples.explanationHtml: Prefix adds one before supplying the expression value. Both fields are five because issued receives the updated value. Compare this with the previous example: the counter ends the same way, while the assigned value differs.

examples.title: Compare two decrements
examples.explanationHtml: Postfix decrement supplies eight and leaves a at seven. Prefix decrement leaves b at seven and supplies seven. The four printed fields separate each expression value from its operand after the full statement. None of the updates are combined unsafely.

practice.title: Issue one roll
practice.statementHtml: Read counter 0 to 1000. After the prompt Input: , print the current counter and its successor separated by a space and newline. Use postfix when saving the current value.
hints: Save the expression value, then print in another statement.

practice.title: Advance a room counter
practice.statementHtml: Read count 0 to 1000. After the prompt Input: , print the prefix increment result and final count, with a space and newline.
hints: Both displayed values should be the new count.

practice.title: One remaining seat
practice.statementHtml: Read seats 1 to 1000. After the prompt Input: , print the old seats and remaining seats after one is taken, separated by a space and newline.
hints: Postfix can preserve the earlier value.

practice.title: Three numbered tickets
practice.statementHtml: Read start 0 to 1000. After the prompt Input: , print three successive issued numbers, then the next available number; use single spaces and newline.
hints: Put each update in its own full expression.

quiz.prompt: For int n = 4; int x = ++n;, which value initializes x?
quiz.explanation: Prefix supplies the value after incrementing.

quiz.prompt: What does postfix n++ supply to its surrounding expression?
quiz.explanation: The operand changes, but the expression supplies its earlier value.

quiz.prompt: When is n changed after x = n++; finishes?
quiz.explanation: The side effect completes within that full expression.

quiz.prompt: Which operand can be incremented here?
quiz.explanation: Increment needs an appropriate modifiable operand.

quiz.prompt: Why is i = i++ invalid to predict in C17?
quiz.explanation: Undefined behavior means no portable final value exists.

quiz.prompt: How should you pass old and new counter values to printf safely?
options: Use i++ and i in the same call
Save and update in earlier separate statements
quiz.explanation: Separate full expressions establish the needed order.

quiz.prompt: What does decrementing unsigned zero do?
options: Wrap to the maximum unsigned value
quiz.explanation: Unsigned arithmetic wraps; the task may still consider that a mistake.

quiz.prompt: Postfix saves the old counter. Which pair is printed?
quiz.explanation: x receives six and n advances to seven.

quiz.prompt: Prefix decrement runs before initialization. Which pair appears?
quiz.explanation: Both values are five after the prefix operation.

quiz.prompt: Two separate updates complete before output. What is n?
quiz.explanation: Each statement adds one, making four.

keyPoints.bn: prefix আগে মান বদলে নতুন মান দেয়।
postfix expression পুরোনো মান দেয়, তবে ভেরিয়েবলও আপডেট হয়।

keyPoints.en: Standalone prefix and postfix have the same final counter.
keyPoints.bn: আলাদা statement হলে দুইভাবেই কাউন্টার এক বাড়ে।

keyPoints.en: Do not update and assign the same counter without sequencing.
keyPoints.bn: এক expression-এ i = i++ লিখো না।

keyPoints.en: Counter updates still need range checks.
keyPoints.bn: কাউন্টার বাড়ানো বা কমানোর সময়ও সীমা খেয়াল রাখো।

examQuestions.question: For int n = 4; int x = ++n;, which value initializes x?
examQuestions.answerHtml: 5. Prefix supplies the value after incrementing.

examQuestions.question: What does postfix n++ supply to its surrounding expression?
examQuestions.answerHtml: The value before increment. The operand changes, but the expression supplies its earlier value.

6 7

x receives six and n advances to seven.

examQuestions.question: Read start 0 to 1000. After Input: print three successive issued numbers, then the next available number; use single spaces and newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int start;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%d", &start) != 1 || start < 0 || start > 1000) {
        return 1;
    }
    int first = start++;
    int second = start++;
    int third = start++;
    printf("%d %d %d %d\n", first, second, third, start);
    return 0;
}

Put each update in its own full expression.
